review_basis: Twelve-frame contact-sheet inspection of the three replacement clips, judged against every exact claim-bound narration use and the visible-content contract authored from the inspected candidate boards.

decisions.reason: All twelve frames show only the EU flag and a neutral cloudy sky. No national building, national flag, person, product or commercial mark can misidentify the institution; the legal detail remains on primary evidence.

All twelve frames show two lab-coated researchers jointly reviewing written notes beside a microscope. Their shared inspection remains clear throughout; no visible brand or unrelated interface carries a factual claim.

Across all twelve frames, an unbranded scientist repeatedly lifts and visually checks one sample tube in a neutral laboratory. The clip reads as methodical inspection, not assembly, repair or endorsement, and asserts no specific test result.
